title: Quantity Rate on Convex Barriers Shipped Above the Ostomy Supply Program Allowance
content:
For the Ostomy Supply Program charge for plan-denied convex barriers (A4407) of a program's most recent convex-barrier refill, a quantity discount applies according to the barriers the refill shipped above the tier's allowance for its supply days.

**Barriers above the allowance** are the units the refill shipped less the tier's allowance times the supply days divided by 30. The tier's allowance for the convex barrier, per 30 days, is 20 on the Ostomy Self-Pay Program, Ostomy Commercial PPO Program, Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program and Ostomy Original Medicare Program, 15 on the Ostomy Commercial HMO Program and 10 on the Ostomy Medicaid Program.

## Schedule

| Barriers above the allowance | Quantity rate |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | 10% (the higher quantity rate) |
| 15 to 29 | 5% (the lower quantity rate) |
| Fewer than 15 | No quantity rate |

**How the rate acts.** The quantity rate comes off the cash price of the barriers concerned on the denied refill.

## Boundaries (hypothetical refill of 30 supply days on a tier with an allowance of 15, so 15 barriers within the allowance)

| Units shipped | Above the allowance | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 29 | 14 | None |
| 30 | 15 | 5% |
| 44 | 29 | 5% |
| 45 | 30 | 10% |
